user_story: As a user, I want to filter tasks by priority so that I can work on the most urgent items first.

positive.title: Filter tasks by high priority
steps: Navigate to the tasks page
Select 'High' from the priority filter dropdown
View the filtered list of tasks
positive.expected_result: The list displays only tasks marked as high priority.

positive.title: Filter tasks by medium priority
steps: Navigate to the tasks page
Select 'Medium' from the priority filter dropdown
View the filtered list of tasks
positive.expected_result: The list displays only tasks marked as medium priority.

positive.title: Filter tasks by low priority
steps: Navigate to the tasks page
Select 'Low' from the priority filter dropdown
View the filtered list of tasks
positive.expected_result: The list displays only tasks marked as low priority.

negative.title: Filter tasks by invalid priority value
steps: Navigate to the tasks page
Select 'Invalid' from the priority filter dropdown
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the selected priority is not valid.

negative.title: Filter tasks with no tasks available
steps: Navigate to the tasks page
Select any priority from the filter dropdown
negative.expected_result: A message is displayed indicating that there are no tasks available.

negative.title: Filter tasks by empty priority selection
steps: Navigate to the tasks page
Leave the priority filter empty
Click the filter button
negative.expected_result: The default task list is displayed without any filters applied.

edge.title: Filter tasks when no priority is set for tasks
steps: Navigate to the tasks page
Select 'High' from the priority filter dropdown
edge.expected_result: The list may display an empty set or inform the user that there are no tasks with the selected priority.

edge.title: Filter tasks with maximum number of tasks
steps: Navigate to the tasks page
Select 'High' from the priority filter dropdown
edge.expected_result: The list displays the maximum number of high priority tasks without performance issues.

edge.title: Filter tasks with all priorities set
steps: Navigate to the tasks page
Select all priority levels (High, Medium, Low)
edge.expected_result: The list displays all tasks regardless of their priority.
